title: HVAC Ductwork Routing 3D Planner
prompt:
Create a single HTML file implementing an interactive 3D HVAC ductwork routing planner using Three.js and GLTFLoader.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (20, 25, 20) looking at the origin.
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Create a 40x40 grid floor (GridHelper) representing a building floor plan at y=0, with subtle gray lines.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (10, 20, 10) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Set the background color to #1a1a2e.
- Load the 'soldier.glb' model using GLTFLoader. Scale it to 2.0 and place it at position (8, 0, 8). This represents a maintenance technician figure for scale reference. Play the first animation clip if available using an AnimationMixer.

## HVAC Duct System
- Implement a node-based duct routing system. The user places duct nodes (junction points) on a plane at a configurable height (default y=3). Consecutive nodes are connected by rectangular duct segments.
- Each duct node is a small sphere (radius 0.3, metallic gray #8899aa). Each duct segment connecting two nodes is a BoxGeometry stretched between them with cross-section width=0.8 and height=0.5, colored #6688aa with metallic material.
- Pre-populate the scene with an initial duct route of 4 nodes: Node0 at (-10, 3, -5), Node1 at (-2, 3, -5), Node2 at (-2, 3, 5), Node3 at (5, 3, 5). Connect them sequentially with duct segments.
- Calculate and track total duct length (sum of Euclidean distances between consecutive nodes).

## Duct Height Adjustment
- Provide a slider (id='heightSlider', range 1 to 10, step 0.5, default 3) and a label (id='heightLabel') showing the current duct plane height.
- When the slider changes, ALL existing duct nodes move to the new y-height, and all duct segments update accordingly. The total length recalculates.

## Node Placement Mode
- A button (id='addNodeBtn') toggles placement mode on/off. When active, the button text reads 'Cancel Placement' and has a red background. When inactive, it reads 'Add Node' with a green background.
- In placement mode, clicking on the floor grid (raycasting against y=0 plane) places a new node at the clicked xz position at the current duct height. The new node is appended to the end of the route and a new duct segment connects it to the previous last node. Placement mode automatically deactivates after placing one node.

## Node Selection & Deletion
- Clicking on an existing duct node (sphere) selects it. The selected node turns orange (#ff8800). Only one node can be selected at a time. Clicking empty space or another node deselects the previous.
- Pressing the Delete key while a node is selected removes that node and its connected segments. Adjacent nodes reconnect: if the deleted node was between two others, a new segment bridges them. If it was an endpoint, just remove it. Recalculate total length.

## Airflow Simulation Toggle
- A button (id='airflowBtn') toggles airflow visualization. When active, small blue spheres (radius 0.15) animate along the duct segments from start to end, looping. Use at least 8 particles distributed along the route. Track their progress as a normalized value 0-1 along the total route.
- Button text: 'Show Airflow' / 'Hide Airflow' depending on state.

## Duct Pressure Calculation
- Display a HUD element (id='pressureDisplay') showing simulated static pressure drop. Calculate as: totalLength * 0.15 (Pa per unit length). Update whenever the route changes.

## HUD / UI Panel
- Position a semi-transparent dark panel (id='hudPanel') in the top-left corner with:
  - Total duct length (id='lengthDisplay', format: 'Length: XX.XX m')
  - Pressure drop (id='pressureDisplay', format: 'Pressure Drop: XX.XX Pa')
  - Node count (id='nodeCountDisplay', format: 'Nodes: N')
  - Current duct height from slider (id='heightLabel', format: 'Height: X.X m')
- Place the addNodeBtn and airflowBtn below the HUD panel.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
  - nodeCount: number of duct nodes
  - totalLength: total duct route length (float)
  - pressureDrop: totalLength * 0.15 (float)
  - ductHeight: current y-height of duct plane (float)
  - selectedNodeIndex: index of selected node or -1 if none
  - placementMode: boolean
  - airflowActive: boolean
  - airflowParticleCount: number of airflow particles currently in scene
  - nodePositions: array of {x, y, z} for each node
  - segmentCount: number of duct segments (nodeCount - 1 for a linear route)
  - soldierLoaded: boolean, true once the GLB model is loaded
  - animationPlaying: boolean, true if soldier animation mixer is active

## Animation Loop
- Use requestAnimationFrame. Update the AnimationMixer delta, update airflow particle positions if active, and render.
physics_constraints: Pressure drop must equal totalLength * 0.15 at all times. Total duct length must equal the sum of Euclidean distances between consecutive nodes. Node deletion must preserve route connectivity for interior nodes. All node y-coordinates must match the current ductHeight. Airflow particles must stay within duct segment bounds.
